description: Search file contents with 80% token reduction through match-only output and smart filtering

count.description: Only return match counts per file

deadlineMs.description: Wall-clock budget in ms for the whole search (default 10000). On expiry the search returns what it found with metadata.searchTruncated set, instead of running until the calling tool times out.

encoding.description: File encoding used to read candidates

ignore.description: Glob patterns to skip. Defaults exclude node_modules, .git, dist and build; pass [] to search everything.

includeColumn.description: Include the 0-based column of each match

maxFileSize.description: Skip files larger than this many bytes

maxMatchesPerFile.description: Stop after this many matches in any one file

offset.description: Skip this many matches before returning any; use with limit to page

path.description: Directory to search. Preferred over cwd; without it the search falls back to the server process directory rather than your project.

ttl.description: Cache lifetime in seconds, when useCache is on

useCache.description: Serve a previously cached result for the same query. Off by default: a cached search is keyed on the query, not on the tree it ran against, so a file created between two identical searches will not appear.

name: smart_grep
